=bin_dir='{{ $('Variables').item.json.bin_dir }}'
mkdir -p "$bin_dir"

dir="$(mktemp -d)"
cd "$dir"

wget 'https://github.com/cooklang/cookcli/releases/download/v0.21.0/cook-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz'
tar xvf cook*
mv -f cook "$bin_dir/cook"

cd "$bin_dir"
chmod +x *
rm -r "$dir"
